title: <policy>.verdict.json
description: One policy judged against one evidence pack, as written by `evidence verdict`. A SIDECAR: it is written next to the pack and never into it, so any sealed pack can be judged at any time without changing its bytes. `pack.sha256` ties the verdict to the exact pack file it judged. See decisions 0047 and 0050.

result.description: errored when the policy could not be judged as a whole or any gate errored; else fail when any blocking gate failed; else pass.

evaluator.description: The tool and version that judged the pack, e.g. "evidence-cli 0.2.0".

sha256.description: sha256 hex of the sealed .evidence file bytes; null when a live directory was judged.
sha256 hex of the exact policy YAML bytes.

catalog.description: The producer catalog the pack carried, or null when it carried none.

source.description: run.yaml metrics_catalog.source as the producer recorded it, or null.

error.description: Set when the policy as a whole could not be judged (pack not finalized or not valid, a policy problem against this pack's catalog). gates is then empty.

failed_gates.description: Ids of blocking gates that failed.

warnings.description: Ids of warning gates that failed.

op.description: The comparison; expr for an expression gate.

expected.description: The threshold as written; true for an expression gate.

actual.description: The resolved value, or null when it could not be resolved.

status.description: warn is a failed warning gate.

trust.description: recomputed: derived from the pack's raw files. file: read from a file in the pack. stored: the producer's own number. null when nothing was resolved.

stored.description: The producer's stored number when it disagreed with the recompute.
